name: android_rotate_gesture
description: Executes a two-finger rotation gesture (clockwise / counter-clockwise) by specified degrees around a center coordinate.

angleDegrees.description: Angle of rotation in degrees (> 0 clockwise, < 0 counter-clockwise). Aliases: angle, degrees, deg.

radius.description: Radius of two-finger touch circle in pixels or normalized ratio (default 200).
